confirmedSemantics: Keep the current top global navigation.
Run records, task results, logs, inputs, outputs, exceptions, evidence, cleanup, and data occupancy are queried facts; UI state does not infer one from another.
Business data status remains independent from Batch, Task, and environment status.
Each Task uses an isolated environment instance; temporary instances are cleaned by default.
An End save directive saves the current environment and associates relevant writable business records without a separate Bind step.

An unknown cleanup result is looked up by the original command identity. Confirmed non-acceptance permits resubmission with the original key. An accepted operation that terminates as failed remains failed evidence; residual cleanup is a new explicit operation.
